Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8010); Solomon (i.e. Shelomoh), the son of David:--Solomon.
BiblicalUsage: Solomon is named in the genealogy as the son David begat, and Jesus holds him up twice. The queen of the south came from the uttermost parts of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon, yet a greater than Solomon is here, and Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of the lilies.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Solomon is the measure of earthly glory and earthly wisdom, and Jesus says plainly that He is greater, and a lily is clothed better.
